model_annotation: Figure 6 consists of three side-by-side line plots that illustrate training dynamics over time for three methods (as indicated by the legend above the panels): On-policy RL (blue), LUFFY (brown/red), and Off-policy Reasoning Traces (yellow), each plotted against training steps on the x-axis. In all three panels, the x-axis is labeled “Steps,” uses a linear scale, and shows evenly spaced numeric ticks (exact tick values are not legible in the image). In the left panel, the y-axis is labeled “Outcome Training Rewards” (linear scale; numeric tick values not legible), and all three lines rise from low values near the left edge and then level off toward the right; the blue line increases steadily to a mid-high plateau, the brown/red line increases and stays slightly higher with small fluctuations, and the yellow line increases quickly to the highest band and remains relatively flat. In the middle panel, the y-axis is labeled “Response Length” (linear scale; numeric ticks not legible), where the blue line remains low and relatively flat after a small early rise, the brown/red line climbs to a much higher level and fluctuates with repeated up-and-down variations across steps, and the yellow line stays highest and fairly flat with minor jitter. In the right panel, the y-axis is labeled “Entropy” (linear scale; numeric ticks not legible), and the blue line drops sharply early and continues decreasing toward a low near-flat level by the right edge, while the brown/red line starts high, declines more gradually with noticeable oscillations, and ends at a moderate level; the yellow series is not visibly present in this entropy panel, and there is an in-panel text annotation reading “Continuous Exploration” near the upper right of the plot area.
